Its principal functions are: (a) to plan, study, design, direct, construct, inspect, operate, maintain, and exploit the water and sewerage systems of the country; (b) to prepare or authorize the preparation of all plans for public works of autonomous agencies insofar as water and sewerage systems are concerned, in accordance with municipal legislation in force and the Sanitary Code. It also approves plans for private works for the same purpose, after due study and in accordance with its own standards; (c) to set up, determine, fix, change, levy and charge reasonable rates, taxes, rents, valuation, and other fees for the use or installation of its facilities, water and sewerage services, or other articles or services lent or supplied by it (Arts. 1 - 5 of Law 98).
